{{Quote|Nothing's free on Nal Hutta.|The bartender to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Friends and Enemies">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref>}}
An '''Ihorian''' [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] was working at a [[Bilbousa saloon/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Bilbousa Bazaar/Legends|Bilbousa Bazaar]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. With the help of an [[Translator collar/Legends|ithorian translator]], he was able to communicate with his patrons in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. When [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] visited the bar and questioned the Ithorian about the whereabouts of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] and [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardee]], the bartender initially was hesitant in revealing that the trio had just passed through. Angered by the Ithorian's stalling tactics, Skywalker used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to make him tell the truth.

==Behind the scenes==
The Ithorion bartender was voiced by [[Stephen Stanton]], who also voiced [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]].
